prompt: Fixed camera. Immediately the clerk pushes paddle 29 up another few inches, arm trembling slightly, and looks towards the lectern with a tired, pleading face. Heads in the rows around him turn; a woman in the back raises her eyebrows. A low murmur rolls through the tent. The "29" on the paddle and the "£150,000" on the board stay exactly as they are and readable. The string lights sway very slightly; the man at the lectern holds his gesture. The clerk keeps his mouth closed. Sound: crowd murmur swelling, light rain on the marquee roof. Natural daylight in a white tent, realistic.
